items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: he gave one to John Reed's wife

ctx.x: used played the clarinet a lot. He played the clarinet in those days. He loved to play the clarinet except on a job he was always a little afraid of it because he couldn't express himself as freely on the clarinet it was a little more delicate you know but at home he loved to sit and play the clarinet.
Oh do you remember anything about his clarinet? I know he gave one of them once when he sort of gave up he had trouble with his teeth he gave one to John Reed's wife you knew John Reed I
suppose had been connected. Yes I know I knew of him I never met him yeah. Remember that was 1943
